methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i recording.mp4 -c:a aac -vn -b:a 192k interview-audio.m4a. If the audio is already AAC, run ffmpeg -i recording.mp4 -vn -c:a copy interview-audio.m4a to copy the stream.
methods.limits: Needs an audio stream; stream copy can fail when the target container lacks information it needs.

methods.steps: With the FFmpeg library installed, File > Import > Audio to open the MP4; File > Export Audio, then M4A (AAC) Files (FFmpeg) from the Format menu.
methods.limits: The AAC bitrate setting is not always honored; for stereo, settings of 196 kbps or less export at 196 to 198 kbps.

methods.steps: Run mpv recording.mp4 --vid=no --oac=aac --oacopts=b=192000 --o=interview-audio.m4a.
methods.limits: --o enables encoding mode; the output format follows the file name unless --of is set.

methods.steps: File > Export As; pick TIFF, then choose a compression in the TIFF export dialog (None, LZW, Pack Bits, Deflate or JPEG).
methods.limits: The JPEG compression option is lossy.

methods.steps: Open the PNG; File > Export; choose TIFF from the Format menu; name the copy and click Save.
methods.limits: Mac only.

methods.steps: Run magick graphic.png graphic.tiff.
methods.limits: The format list notes extensive strip, tile, endian and compression tag controls for TIFF.

methods.steps: Open the SVG; File > Export; choose JPEG in the Export dialog's format list and set the export area and DPI; export.
methods.limits: Needs the Export dialog of Inkscape 1.2 or later.

methods.steps: Open the SVG, which GIMP loads as an image; File > Export As, save in JPEG format and set Quality (0 to 100, default 85) in the dialog.
methods.limits: GIMP's JPEG export has no transparency or multiple layers; the SVG is rasterized.

methods.steps: Run magick drawing.svg picture.jpg.
methods.limits: The format list says SVG is rendered through Inkscape, RSVG or the internal MSVG renderer.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i capture.webm -c:v libx264 -c:a aac result.mov.
methods.limits: Add options to set the preset, size or frame rate; this example sets none.

methods.steps: Run mpv capture.webm --ovc=libx264 --oac=aac --o=result.mov.
methods.limits: Uses mpv's encoding mode; the output format is picked from the file name unless --of is set.

methods.steps: Open BMP; File > Export; choose PDF and save.
methods.limits: Mac only.

methods.steps: Open BMP; File > Export As; give the file a .pdf name, then export.
methods.limits: Layers as pages is disabled for a single-layer image.

methods.steps: Run magick scan.bmp scan.pdf.
methods.limits: The format list says PDF requires Ghostscript.

methods.steps: Editor > the hard disk icon below the preview opens the Save window; choose PNG and a bit depth; save immediately or put in the queue.
methods.limits: Saving immediately keeps RawTherapee busy until the save finishes; the queue keeps the editor responsive.

methods.steps: Run magick cr2:photograph.cr2 photograph.png.
methods.limits: The format list marks CR2 read-only and requires the explicit cr2: specifier.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i album.flac -vn -c:a alac album.m4a.
methods.limits: Keep -vn when the FLAC has cover art, or FFmpeg may fail.

methods.steps: Open GIF; File > Export As; give the file a .pdf name; optionally choose Layers as pages.
methods.limits: Frames that depend on earlier frames can look incomplete as separate pages.

methods.steps: Open GIF; File > Export; choose PDF as the format.
methods.limits: Mac only.

methods.steps: Run magick 'animation.gif[0]' still.pdf.
methods.limits: The format list says PDF requires Ghostscript.

methods.steps: Display JPEG; File > Export; set Format to TIFF; save a new file.
methods.limits: Mac only; no compression settings.

methods.steps: Import JPG; File > Export As; choose TIFF and pick a compression method in the TIFF dialog.
methods.limits: Avoid the JPEG compression option when the goal is to stop adding loss.

methods.steps: Run magick portrait.jpg portrait.tiff.
methods.limits: The format list notes controls for compression, strips, tiles and byte order.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i movie.mkv -map 0:a:0 -vn -c:a pcm_s16le sound.wav; change the -map value to pick another audio stream.
methods.limits: Command line; list the streams first to choose the right one.

methods.steps: Run mpv movie.mkv --vid=no --oac=pcm_s16le --o=sound.wav.
methods.limits: Uses mpv's encoding mode; the output format follows the file name.
